## Declarations and implementations

```plato

//==
// # Emitters

// The region a particle emitter spawns from; Cone carries the half-angle of
// its emission cone.
type EmitterShape
    = Point
    | Sphere
    | Box
    | Cone(HalfAngle: Angle)
    | Circle
    | Mesh;

// A planar particle source. Rate is the continuous spawn rate; BurstCount
// particles are also released at each burst. SpeedRange is in meters per
// second, LifetimeRange in seconds, SizeRange in meters (each sampled
// uniformly); ColorOverLife maps normalized age to tint; Arc bounds the
// emission directions; Seed drives deterministic randomness.
type ParticleEmitter2D
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: EmitterShape;
    Pose: Pose2D;
    Rate: Frequency;
    BurstCount: Integer;
    SpeedRange: NumberInterval;
    LifetimeRange: NumberInterval;
    SizeRange: NumberInterval;
    ColorOverLife: ColorGradient;
    Arc: Angle;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// A spatial particle source. Rate is the continuous spawn rate; BurstCount
// particles are also released at each burst. SpeedRange is in meters per
// second, LifetimeRange in seconds, SizeRange in meters (each sampled
// uniformly); ColorOverLife maps normalized age to tint; Seed drives
// deterministic randomness.
type ParticleEmitter3D
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: EmitterShape;
    Pose: Pose3D;
    Rate: Frequency;
    BurstCount: Integer;
    SpeedRange: NumberInterval;
    LifetimeRange: NumberInterval;
    SizeRange: NumberInterval;
    ColorOverLife: ColorGradient;
    Seed: Integer;
}

//==
// # Particle systems

// A complete planar particle simulation: live particles, their sources, and
// the force fields acting on them (interpreted in the XY plane). Time is the
// simulation clock.
type ParticleSystem2D
    implements IValue
{
    Particles: Array<Particle2D>;
    Emitters: Array<ParticleEmitter2D>;
    Gravities: Array<ParticleGravity>;
    Drags: Array<ParticleDrag>;
    Vortices: Array<ParticleVortex>;
    Attractors: Array<ParticleAttractor>;
    Turbulences: Array<ParticleTurbulence>;
    Winds: Array<WindModel>;
    Time: Instant;
}

// A complete spatial particle simulation: live particles, their sources, and
// the force fields acting on them. Time is the simulation clock.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Particle_system)
type ParticleSystem3D
    implements IValue
{
    Particles: Array<Particle3D>;
    Emitters: Array<ParticleEmitter3D>;
    Gravities: Array<ParticleGravity>;
    Drags: Array<ParticleDrag>;
    Vortices: Array<ParticleVortex>;
    Attractors: Array<ParticleAttractor>;
    Turbulences: Array<ParticleTurbulence>;
    Winds: Array<WindModel>;
    Time: Instant;
}

//==
// # Cloth, rope, and fluids
//
// Position-based deformables and particle fluids: cloth and rope vertices
// with the distance and bend constraints binding them, soft-body solver
// settings, and smoothed-particle hydrodynamics. Positions are in meters,
// velocities in meters per second, masses in kilograms.

//==
// # Cloth and rope

// One vertex of a position-based cloth or rope. PreviousPosition is the
// position at the last step (Verlet state); InverseMass is in units of one
// per kilogram, with 0 meaning infinite mass; Pinned freezes the vertex
// regardless of mass.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verlet_integration)
type ClothVertex
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    PreviousPosition: Point3D;
    InverseMass: Number;
    Pinned: Boolean;
}

// A stretch constraint keeping two cloth vertices (zero-based indices) at
// RestLength. Compliance is the inverse stiffness in meters per newton;
// 0 makes the constraint rigid.
type ClothDistanceConstraint
    implements IValue
{
    VertexA: VertexIndex;
    VertexB: VertexIndex;
    RestLength: Length;
    Compliance: Number;
}

// A bending constraint over two triangles sharing the edge (VertexA,
// VertexB), with wing vertices VertexC and VertexD: it drives the dihedral
// angle between them toward RestAngle. Compliance is the inverse stiffness in
// radians per newton-meter; 0 makes the fold rigid.
type ClothBendConstraint
    implements IValue
{
    VertexA: VertexIndex;
    VertexB: VertexIndex;
    VertexC: VertexIndex;
    VertexD: VertexIndex;
    RestAngle: Angle;
    Compliance: Number;
}

// A position-based cloth: vertices, the constraints binding them, and the
// triangles used for rendering and collision. Thickness is the collision
// shell radius.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cloth_modeling)
type Cloth3D
    implements IValue
{
    Vertices: Array<ClothVertex>;
    DistanceConstraints: Array<ClothDistanceConstraint>;
    BendConstraints: Array<ClothBendConstraint>;
    Faces: Array<TriangleFace>;
    Thickness: Length;
}
```
